question.text: Look at these two fractions.
Do these two fractions have the same size parts?
Choose a common denominator for both fractions.
Rename the first fraction with 12 equal parts.
Rename the second fraction with 12 equal parts.
Add the shaded parts together.
The answer is 11/12.
Does this new bar show the same amount as before?

controls.label: Yes, it is the same amount
